about.label: ABOUT
about.bigCopy1: My background sits at the intersection of
about.profile1: I am a computer science engineer specializing in Operations Research and Optimization, with experience in mathematical modeling, optimization algorithms, Machine Learning, and scientific software development.
about.profile2: I design and implement data-driven decision-support solutions for complex industrial problems, combining mathematical optimization, predictive modeling, and modern software engineering. My experience includes energy management systems, renewable energy integration, and the development of optimization and forecasting models.
about.profile3: My technical background spans Python, C++, Java, mathematical programming, and optimization tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, and Pyomo.

projects.label: SELECTED WORK
projects.subtitle: A selection of technical and research projects across energy, aeronautics and industrial software.

p01.title: ENERBIRD / Hybrid Energy Management
p01.text: Optimal control and energy management for hybrid renewable power plants combining solar/wind generation and battery storage. Optimization models are coupled with forecasting and real-time operational constraints.

p02.title: E3S — Energy Smart Sailing Ship
p02.text: Hybrid intelligent energy-management system for a long-range sailing ship. The project combines renewable sources, diesel generation and battery storage with robust optimization under weather uncertainty.

p03.title: High-Voltage Substation Simulation
p03.text: Backend software development for simulation of high-voltage substation cards, with a strong focus on reliability, architecture, testing and maintainable modern C++.

p04.title: Air Traffic Conflict Resolution
p04.text: Exact and approximate approaches for resolving aircraft conflicts, exploring mathematical modeling, combinatorial optimization and metaheuristics in an air-traffic-management context.

e01.role: R&D Engineer in Optimization & Machine Learning
e01.text: Supporting clients in the development of optimal management solutions for hybrid energy systems in non-interconnected zones (ZNI), with a focus on real-time optimization and production forecasting for renewable power plants.
missions: Develop optimal management solutions for hybrid renewable energy systems (solar, wind, battery storage) in non-interconnected zones
Maximize hybrid power plant revenues through real-time production optimization
Optimize energy dispatch according to announced programs and actual plant conditions
Build and continuously update production forecasting models for operational planning
Clients: Omexom, Valorem, Urbasolar — Territories: Corsica, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Réunion, Mayotte
e01.tech: Python · MILP · MINLP · Pyomo · Machine Learning · SCADA · Real-Time Optimization

e02.text: Back-end development of Vcard, a software application for simulating high-voltage substation cards, within the Reliability engineering team.
missions: Develop and maintain the Vcard simulation software for high-voltage electrical substation cards
Design and implement back-end architecture for reliability-critical software systems
Write and maintain comprehensive automated test suites (unit and integration)
Apply modern C++ best practices: RAII, design patterns, static analysis, code review
e02.tech: C++ · Simulation · Back-End Architecture · Unit Testing · Reliability Engineering

e03.text: Software development phase of the E3S (Energy Smart Sailing Ship) project: design and implementation of the embedded energy management system and its optimization algorithms.
missions: Implement and optimize the C++ EMS core for the E3S hybrid energy system
Develop Java components within the project's service-oriented architecture
Integrate energy optimization models (GLPK) with real-time operational constraints
Validate and test the hybrid EMS across multiple energy source scenarios
e03.tech: C++ · Java · GLPK · EMS · Optimization · MATLAB

e04.text: Research and prototyping of a hybrid intelligent energy management system (EMS) for a long-range sailing vessel equipped with multiple renewable energy sources, as part of the E3S project.
missions: Design a hybrid intelligent EMS managing solar, wind, hydrogenerator, diesel and battery sources
Model and optimize energy production and consumption flows on board
Formulate and solve robust optimization models under weather and operational uncertainty
Ensure navigation safety and passenger comfort through reliable energy management
e04.tech: C++ · GLPK · EMS · Robust Optimization · MATLAB · Renewable Energy Systems
